title: CYC1: cyclic extraction with exact all-width caps

claims.statement: For CYC1 as fully specified in proof.md, for every integer N>=2 and fixed s in Z/NZ, let n=ceil(log2 N) and L=log2 n. Use the least feasible integer profile of Section 4, the cyclic instrument, source/decoder routines, exact rational all-D budget rule and two deterministic global caps of Section 8, and the explicit exhaustive finite branch for n<256. From independent ideal DCP source copies, unconditional entire-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. All four resource bounds hold jointly on every execution branch, including failed attempts, rejected copies, incorrect labels and aborts. All hidden constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. Total sequential charged work is T=O(n^(9/2) L^(3/2) 2^(sqrt(nL)+sqrt n)). This includes all source costs, bit operations, gates, exact Clifford+T decomposition, streamed circuit generation, initialization, measurements, resets, memory access, address costs, preprocessing, finite precision and decoding. The full supported uniform envelope has exact growth index 1/2. The asymptotic expression applies for n>=2; the fixed finite branch covers all smaller cases.

Total fresh source acquisitions obey Q<=Qcap=ceil(1024(2 Emax H0+2n)) in the main branch, with Emax,H0 fixed by the exact rule in Section 8; the finite branch uses at most N(n+10) copies. Uniformly Q=O(n^(3/2) L^(1/2) 2^(sqrt(nL)+sqrt n-(1/3)sqrt(n/L))). This includes every rejected, discarded, retried and partially constructed sample, not just surviving leaves. From independent ideal DCP source copies, unconditional entire-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. All four resource bounds hold jointly on every execution branch, including failed attempts, rejected copies, incorrect labels and aborts. All hidden constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. For every N>=2 and s the guaranteed malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal rho_s; at most floor(epsilon(n) Q)=0 acquired copies may be malformed. Under precisely that clean-input promise, the same success probability and all four every-branch resource guarantees above hold. No positive tolerance or impossibility of positive tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
